summary: Iteration 4 major refactor verified end-to-end. All new wing/sub-card/mixed-chip testids exist and behave correctly. Data assignment matches spec exactly: Wing Kiri=3 TO (Qty 33, Avg Bin/TO 3, Avg Qty/Bin 4.1), Wing Kanan=2 TO (Qty 8, 1, 4.0), Cross Wing=7 TO (Qty 45, 1, 6.4). Sub-cards distribution correct: Kiri 1-6=1 TO (5330157, Qty 2), Kiri 7-12=0, Kiri 13-18=0, Mixed Kiri=2 TO Qty 31. Kanan 19-24=1 (Qty 2), 25-30=1 (Qty 6), 31-36=0, Mixed Kanan=0. Mixed chips: Semua=2/31, 2 Row=1/9 (5330147), 3 Row=0, 4 Row=1/22 (5330146), 5 Row=0, >5=0. Cross Wing click does NOT open subcards panel and shows 7 TOs. Clear filter resets header to only [No | Transfer Order Number]. Search input filters correctly. Reset Data clears dataset to 0 records. No React console errors/warnings observed during full interaction flow.

issues: Spec says 'hides card grid' after Reset Data, but the 3 wing cards + sub-card region remain visible with 0 values (screenshot confirms). Minor UX deviation from spec; either update spec or hide cards when dataset is empty.

action_items: Optional: after Reset Data, consider hiding the '3. Menu Card Range' section entirely (or show an empty-state placeholder) since spec explicitly mentions 'hides card grid'. Currently cards render with all-zero metrics.

Optional cleanup: header badge text 'Records Loaded' + '0' wraps as two lines in DOM (regex captured 'Records Loaded\n1' — the '1' actually belongs to a following element). Purely cosmetic — screenshot renders correctly as '0 Records Loaded'.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~1370 lines — consider splitting into components/hooks (WingCard, SubCardPanel, MixedSubFilterBar, TOTable, useWingAssignments hook) to improve maintainability and testability.

computeBucketStats is called from a useMemo but declared outside useCallback — memoization dependencies (toRowInfo) are captured via closure. Not a bug because it's recreated each render, but wrapping in useCallback would be cleaner.
wingLevelStats useMemo dependency list omits WING_STRUCTURE and computeBucketStats — since these are stable per-render this is fine, but ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps may flag it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all functional testids and metrics validated); 1 minor spec deviation

seed_data_creation: None — used built-in INITIAL_RAW_DATA (17 rows) as documented in mocked_api.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend hierarchy fully working: wing-card-{left|right|cross} → subcards-panel-{left|right} with subcard-range-{wing}-{key} + subcard-mixed-{wing} → mixed-subfilter-{all|2|3|4|5|gt5}. Cross Wing has no subcards. Reset Data clears data to []. Clear-filter-btn resets wing+subcard. Only remaining spec deviation is cosmetic (cards still visible with 0 metrics after Reset Data).
